# Qualixar Jev Decision Layer

> One decision runtime with host adapters for Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, Hermes and VS Code. Bounded typed Jev decisions for coding-agent workflows, with an optional local Laya route. Answers are gated locally and never grant tool authority.

Hosted TypeSafe Jev and OpenRouter target macOS, Linux and Windows; native Windows/Linux CI remains a release gate. Local Laya-MLX is limited to compatible Apple-Silicon Macs. This index is a reading convenience for agents, not a guarantee of search ranking or universal host support. Every claim about a specific harness is qualified in the host guide by what was actually run.

Release 1.0.11 contains 38 recipes and 114 synthetic offline fixtures. To evaluate it without a key, provider call or enrolled workspace, run `plugins/qualixar-jev-decision-layer/scripts/jev selftest`: it replays the fixture set through the real gate offline. A passing run is a contract check on the shipped gate, never evidence of provider accuracy.
